Family tree notes (old copy, January)

Kessler side
- Arthur Kessler, born 1921, farmer; married Ilse Brandt 1947
- Their children: Marta (1948), Peter (1951), Lena (1955)

Brandt side
- Ilse Brandt, born 1925; her parents Karl and Anna Brandt

UNFINISHED - Arthur's war years (added last week, not in the tidy copy yet)
- Called up 1941; letters from the Eastern front kept in the blue tin
- Field post number 31442B, regiment still to be confirmed with the archive
- Hospital stay in Vienna, winter 1943: ask Aunt Lena for the dates
- Returned 1946 on foot; the story Peter told about the boots needs checking
